scope_notes: Coverage is against current documented mechanics, including supporting operations and test evidence. Catalog labels for existing unnamed formats do not rename source files or established wire names.

Each named ability, talent and recipe is content within a shared format, not a distinct contract. Specialization combat states are separate because their documented histories and decision loops differ.
Live interfaces and durable or wire schemas are listed separately only for distinct responsibilities. This catalog specifies none of their members.

Housing, territory construction, sieges, detailed authored maps, racial geography, neutral trade, long offline manufacturing and mandatory voice chat have no current baseline requirements. No contracts are invented for those deferred or absent features.
Quest and world entries cover the documented starter journey, objective tracking, safe locations and explicit transitions. Authored narrative remains deferred.

review_issues.question: Several class and specialization labels differ from their resource contracts: Grace/Devotion, Soul Threshold/Soul Essence, Maelstrom/Stormcharge, Pact Shards/Authority, and Focus Windows/Aim. Confirm the eventual public terminology without creating duplicate meters.
Minstrel resource contracts use Mana and Harmonies, while Balm Chorus and several talents still refer to Cadence spending or retention. Which references should eventually govern?

Ranger Prepared Retreat and Marksman Steady Distance still refer to accuracy, while the attribute rules and audit retire a random accuracy statistic. Clarify the intended non-random behavior before defining its state.
Item grade has an explicit budget role; rarity color is mentioned separately without an authoritative rarity vocabulary. Decide whether ItemRarity remains a separate classification.
Clause-based play is documented, but the authoritative clause set and distinction between clause choices and talent routes are unresolved.

The starter guide must introduce tasks and specialization, but authored story dialogue is deferred. Decide whether this needs a dedicated dialogue format or the existing interaction/tutorial contracts.

The combat prose names revalidation_policy; shipped abilities use target_revalidation and timing_policy. Preserve these established references until their relationship is decided. ability_command_v2 remains the exact existing wire-schema name.

Combat describes normalized weighting across support providers; the testing chapter describes deterministic ordered marginal attribution. Decide which accounting policy should govern before defining contribution records.
